ns2:course.label: Current Topics in Biochemistry
ns2:course.description: Capstone course of the Biochemistry Specialized Curriculum, designed to expose undergraduate seniors to developing areas of research in biochemistry. Each year the course will cover 3 to 4 topics of high current research activity, each presented by one faculty member. Readings will be based on the primary lecture. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Senior standing in the Biochemistry Specialized Curriculum; MCB 354 and MCB 406 or consent of instructor.
